title: Spring constant value
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for part (1) must be k = 100 N/m.

title: Friction coefficient value
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for part (2) must be μ = 0.4.

title: Static equilibrium analysis
description: Important Criteria: The solution must apply vertical force balance in Figure A to equate spring force to weight (k(l1 - l0) = mg).

title: Dynamic equilibrium analysis
description: Important Criteria: The solution must apply horizontal force balance in Figure B to equate friction force to compressed spring force (k(l0 - l2) = μ mg).

title: Correct Hooke's Law application
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly apply Hooke's Law, using the appropriate spring deformation (l1 - l0 for stretch, l0 - l2 for compression).

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The solution should demonstrate consistent unit conversion (e.g., cm to m) or state final units correctly.

title: Sign error in compression
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student incorrectly uses (l2 - l0) for the compressed spring force, leading to a negative or incorrect value.

title: Misidentifying equilibrium condition
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student assumes acceleration in Figure B or misapplies Newton's second law instead of constant-speed (dynamic equilibrium).
